summary: OpenAI announces Project Camellia, a data center infrastructure project in Effingham County, Georgia, including commitments to energy, community investment, jobs, and local access to Codex.

mechanisms.reason: The announcement describes a new AI infrastructure project with energy commitments, implying new datacenter power demand in the region.
